verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that users can delete mailbox content, for example by asking Gemini to delete multiple emails or by managing messages through the Gmail API. Nothing documents retention policies, auto-deletion schedules, or control over how Google retains user or AI-processed data. Missing for 10: documented retention settings or policies, scheduled or automatic deletion, controls over vendor-side or AI data retention, account-level data deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
The Gmail API lets you view and manage Gmail mailbox data like threads, messages, and labels.
